name: Template Mod
description: A working template demonstrating every mount point, both table shapes, the event bus, a macro, a fact, a budget claim, and the canonical subscription/cleanup patterns. Copy this folder, rename the `id`, DELETE the `dev` flag above, and edit from there. `dev: true` keeps this template switched off for players who never asked for it; your mod wants the normal default, which is on. See docs/MODDING.md for the prose reference and docs/narrative-mod-api.d.ts for the type surface.
author: Narrative Engine
